params.body:
Transport with payments, walked end to end on 15 September 2026 against a hand-written tariff table, fixed where the code was plainly wrong, and pinned in `tests/Feature/TransportChainTest.php` (37 tests) and `tests/Feature/TransportMailTest.php` (6 tests). Every expected amount in the tests is arithmetic on the table in the class comment, not a copy of what the code produced.

## First: the request modal is usable again

The request/detail dialog carried the class `modal` on its own `modal-dialog`, which made the dialog `position: fixed`, height 100 % and `overflow: hidden`: a form taller than the window lost its header and its footer with no way to scroll (staging, 1440×1100; reproduced at 1440×900 with a vehicle without dimensions). Same shape as PR 340 for the offer/order modals: stray class removed, the modal scrolls itself, sticky header, `align-items: safe center`. Verified at 1440×900, 1440×1100 and 390×844: footer reachable, delivery select opens at its field. The detail modal shares the wrapper and is fixed with it.

## The 13 rules

| Rule | Says | Holds / fixed / disputed |
|---|---|---|
| S4-10.1 eligibility | dims > 0, chassis, make, model, km > 0, complete, right, conditions accepted | **fixed**: was checked only by a red alert in the form; the server now refuses (422) and the request must be for an own vehicle (404). Pinned both ways. |
| S4-10.2 indicative price | default dimensions per model; only when pickup country = dealer country | **disputed**: arithmetic holds and is pinned; the detail page shows it to administrators only (`isAdmin()`), never to a dealer. V-25 for Ilse. |
| S4-10.3 addresses | delivery required, own delivery location; pickup = seller location / seller address / own address | **fixed**: delivery_id is now validated as an own delivery location; for a bought vehicle the form SHOWED the seller's stock location but STORED the seller's dealer address (the form never posted pick_up_id). One derivation now. Pinned. |
| S4-10.4 dimensions saved on the vehicle | when the vehicle has 0 | holds, pinned (also: never overwrites existing). |
| S4-10.5 price class | strictly between min and max of a band | **fixed + disputed**: the pivot relation had its two keys swapped, so with a tariff table where band ids and class ids differ the form showed "unknown" (no price) or the wrong class. Pinned with non-coinciding ids and at the exact boundaries. The strict comparison leaves a vehicle of exactly 4500 mm in no band: V-23. |
| S4-10.6 price | base + margin per country, express ×50 %, report surcharge always, ×1.21 | holds, pinned literally: Middel BE→BE (200+23.50+50)×1.21 = **330.94**, express **451.94**, Hoog **391.44**, Klein express **361.19**; cross-border → no price. Total now rounded to the cent (Mollie gets two decimals). "Elektrische wagen" in the code is the handover report on screen. VAT hardcoded 21 %: V-24. |
| S4-10.7 status / office price | price_available or price_requested; admin enters price_received | **fixed**: the request was filled with `$request->all()` on a model guarding only `id`, so `state=paid` or `total=1` was stored; now only delivery/express/comment. "Back" re-opened a NEW request (duplicate transports); now the same one is updated. Admin price only on price_requested, > 0, comma or point. |
| S4-10.8 mails | price_requested → office + dealer; price_received → dealer with link; paid → office, dealer, seller, recipient language | **fixed**: the price_received link opened nothing (index only opened `price_available`); the paid mail printed "betaald is bij ." for an own vehicle (no seller). Three paid mails restructured (what happened, what next, whom to ask, then details; office mail leads with the task and a button). All six render and are pinned, seller present and absent. |
| S4-10.9 pay | waiting_payment, Mollie payment for the total, redirect to checkout | **fixed**: the pay route was outside `auth`, took any uuid, and set waiting_payment BEFORE checking: a paid transport fell back to waiting when its link was reopened. Now auth + owner/admin, payable state only, paid stays paid; a payment Mollie reports paid settles the transport. Exact Mollie body pinned. **Verified for real by Shane on staging (test mode, €257,73).** |
| S4-10.10 webhook | paid → paid with method; no real payment outside production | **fixed**: crashed (500, Mollie retries for hours) on an unknown id, a non-transport payment or a vanished transport; now 404. Idempotent: a second "paid" changes nothing and mails nothing. Payment id stored. Pinned for paid/open/pending/failed/expired/canceled, unknown id, another transport's payment. **Verified for real by Shane on staging.** |
| S4-10.11 planning states | transport_requested → pickup_confirmed → completed; dealer own, admin all | holds in code; **unreachable on screen** through the header "Acties" menu (off-screen, labels cut; another agent fixes that markup). Added the next step ON the transport: one button in the detail modal with only the next legal step, refused otherwise (422). Pinned dealer/admin/illegal. Checkbox got a tooltip. |
| S4-10.12 cancel | cancelled, "no check who requested" | **fixed**: any logged-in user could cancel any transport in any state. Now requesting dealer or admin, only before payment (422 with message after). |
| S4-10.13 overview | own transports; admin all | holds, pinned (overview and detail). |

Plus R S4-8.12 (webhook): rewritten; failed/expired/canceled now put a waiting transport back on `price_available` instead of leaving it in `waiting_payment` for good (was `betwist`).

New rules: **R S4-10.14** (delivery select is neutral until a submit without a choice; a dealer without a delivery address gets the create action, not "verplicht") and **R S4-10.15** (return from Mollie says paid / not paid / processing; both orders webhook-then-return and return-then-webhook pinned).

## What else changed on the screens

- Return from Mollie: `redirectUrl` now goes to `transports/return/{uuid}`; green notify with the amount and what follows, row highlighted; red notify and payable again on failure; "wordt verwerkt" with a short poll (`transports/status/{uuid}`) when the webhook has not arrived yet.
- Confirmation step reads back the request in the same two columns as the form; footer is one primary ("Bevestig en betaal") on the right, "Terug" beside it, cancel as a quiet red text action on the far left; "sluiten" only when nothing else applies. The header badge updates to the real state after submitting.
- Settings tab: the two preview columns now read `€ 213,00` like the rest of the app (the base-price input still parses a point only: finding `transport-tarief-invoer-enkel-punt`, not fixed here).
- Flash toasts can carry a tone (`message_tone`), so a failed payment comes back red.
- `MaintenanceModeTest::test_the_mollie_webhook_stays_open` now expects the controller's 404 for a payment that is not a transport's (the assertion is that maintenance mode did not answer).

## Verified for real vs. faked

- Real, in a running application with my own database and a browser: request form, class, price, cross-border no-price, office price entry, mail link, detail modal, next-step button, cancel, overview as dealer and admin, return page for a paid transport, all six mails rendered.
- Faked: everything that talks to Mollie (`MollieService` swapped; the exact create body and every webhook status are asserted in tests). Shane completed the real Mollie test-mode payment on staging today (checkout → webhook → "Betaald").

## Findings left for a human

`docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/2026-09-15-transport-*.md` (15 files; 12 `opgelost`, 3 `open`): richtprijs-enkel-voor-beheerder (Ilse), tarief-invoer-enkel-punt (Shane), tarieftabel-op-een-telefoon (Shane). V-questions for Ilse: **V-23** boundary of a band, **V-24** VAT fixed at 21 %, **V-25** indicative price for dealers, **V-26** who is "the office" for cross-border prices and whether the typed amount includes express/report/VAT (`docs/acceptatietest.md`, `docs/vragen-ilse-2026-09-14.md`).

## Staging checklist for Shane (Mollie test key)

1. Log in as a dealer who accepted the five transport conditions and has a delivery address (Instellingen → Transport). Open Bestelbonnen → truck icon on a complete vehicle with dimensions, or `transports?vId=<base64 id>`.
2. The modal must scroll; the footer "Prijs aanvragen" must be reachable at your window size. Class and price must match the settings tab: (basisprijs + marge + overdrachtsrapport [+ 50 % basisprijs if express]) × 1,21.
3. Choose a delivery address, "Prijs aanvragen". The badge turns "Prijs beschikbaar"; the footer shows "Aanvraag annuleren", "Terug", "Bevestig en betaal".
4. "Bevestig en betaal" → Mollie test checkout. Pick **iDEAL** or **Bancontact** and choose status **Paid** on Mollie's test screen (test mode shows a status picker instead of a bank; for cards use `4543 4740 0224 9996`, any future expiry, any CVC).
5. Back on `transports?paid=<uuid>`: green notify "Je transport is betaald (€ …)…", the row highlighted, status "Betaald". If the webhook is slower than your browser you see "Je betaling wordt verwerkt" and the page refreshes itself within ~25 s.
6. Mails: with `MAIL_MAILER=log` read `storage/logs/laravel.log`; otherwise they land at `MAIL_ALWAYS_TO` (APP_DEBUG redirect): "Betaald transport: inplannen" (office), "Je transportaanvraag is succesvol betaald." (dealer), and for a bought vehicle "Ophaling via transportfirma" (seller). No blank names.
7. Repeat step 4 choosing **Failed** or **Canceled**: red notify "De betaling is niet gelukt…", status back to "Prijs beschikbaar", "Bevestig en betaal" available again.
8. Open the detail of the paid transport: one button "Transport als transport aangevraagd zetten"; click it, then "pick-up bevestigd", then "afgehandeld". A second dealer must get 404 on the same uuid.
9. Cancel: only offered before payment; on a paid transport the cancel route answers 422.
params.title: Transport with payments: proven, fixed where needed, pinned
